Thanks again for agreeing to a technical walkthrough so your platform team can evaluate integration patterns and performance expectations. We put together a proposed agenda and two potential windows next week.

- 15m: Introductions & business objectives
- 40m: Architecture deep dive (runtime, routing, security)
- 20m: Integration patterns & telemetry
- 15m: Next steps / mutual action plan

1) Wed, Jan 18 — 09:00–10:30
2) Fri, Jan 20 — 11:00–12:30

Laura Bennett (Head of Product) is tentatively available but I wanted to confirm with you whether that level of representation from Redwood would be useful on your side.

Attachments: redwood-acme-tech-walkthrough-agenda.pdf, exec-briefing-one-pager.docx
